items.name: Consume Tattooed Flesh
items.text:
Requirements Aller is adjacent to a tattooed scrap of flesh or to the corpse of a creature that died within the last hour

Aller devours a bite of flesh and regains 4d6 healing Hit Points. If the piece of flesh was tattooed, he is also Quickened and can use this extra action to make a jaws Strike.

Aller then can't Consume Flesh for 1d4 rounds. He has one piece of tattooed flesh on his person.

items.name: Ghoul Fever
items.text:
Saving Throw DC 22 Fortitude save

---

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 2d6 void damage and regains half as many Hit Points from all healing (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 2d6 void damage and gains no benefit from healing (1 day)

Stage 5 as stage 4 (1 day)

Stage 6 dead, and rises as a Ghoul the next midnight.

items.name: Paralysis
items.text: Any living, non-elf creature hit by Aller's attack must succeed at a DC 22 Fortitude save save or become Paralyzed. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save.

items.name: Swift Leap
items.text: Aller jumps up to half his Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.
